transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I've just been feeling really deeply depressed and sad for a long time now, for about a year and seven months. It feels like this heavy cloud is constantly over me, and I just can't seem to shake it.

During this past year and seven months, have there been any periods of a few weeks or more where your mood significantly worsened, or has your low mood remained relatively consistent throughout this entire time?

My low mood has been pretty consistent the entire time. I haven't really had periods where it got significantly worse and then improved; it has just been a steady, heavy weight for the last year and seven months.
